title: Hobrac: a reference-guided workflow for genome comparison and synteny visualization
authors: Istace, B., Denoeud, F., Teodori, E. et al.
abstract: Whole-genome comparison is fundamental for validating genome assemblies and investigating genome evolution, yet identifying suitable reference genomes and interpreting chromosome-scale synteny from often noisy nucleotide alignments remain challenging. We introduce Hobrac, an automated workflow that addresses these two major bottlenecks by combining automated reference genome selection with gene-based structural comparisons.
